text:
Choose four consecutive 2-digit whole numbers (e.g. 23, 24, 25, 26)

Multiply the first and last numbers together using the grid method. (e.g. 23 x 26)

Now multiply the middle pair together using the grid method. (e.g. 24 x 25)

What is the difference between the two answers?

Now try again with a different set of four consecutive numbers. What have you noticed? Can you explain what happened? Will it always happen?
